+#define ARRAYS_HASHCODE_REGISTERS   \
+  do {                              \
+    assert(result   == r0  &&       \
+           ary      == r1  &&       \
+           cnt      == r2  &&       \
+           blocks   == r3  &&       \
+           tail     == r4  &&       \
+           sum      == r5  &&       \
